configuration_choice: assistant-selected defaults under user delegation; static evidence only, not live joint acceptance

source_O.compatibility_policy: external DeepSeek API/settings/calendar/isolated environment and read-only evidence adapters only; keep original planner and OWL/CAMEL execution; no new router/tool transplant

source_N.attack_backend_policy: must run native current workflow with sufficient observable semantics; cannot silently use legacy path only for attacks; missing capability remains NOT_READY

scope.independence_rule: recurrent attempts and steps are clustered in one episode; episodes share run environment, so not 270 independent observations

A.eligibility: business owner or collaborator with legitimate access to synthetic domain documents; not a system administrator requirement

B.eligibility: one system/service administrator with scoped fixture privileges, never host administrator

C.identity: masquerader controlling a permitted scenario identity
C.eligibility: business account context plus distinct disabled former-employee fixture account for gen_attack_10; fixture is not a 13th employee agent

D.eligibility: general records/support user with only task-appropriate permissions

NORMAL_OVERTIME.eligibility: choose an employee outside A/B/C/D by same deterministic rank

variants.primary_generalization_scope: seen attack taxonomy with held-out generated runs, people, business instances and split-specific prompt variants; not unseen-attack-family generalization
variants.prompt_template_gate: split-specific realized prompts must be frozen and checked for literal/near duplicate leakage before paid generation; shared high-level canonical taxonomy is allowed and disclosed

truth_policy.positive_requires: policy-defined malicious action actually attempted with native tool/application evidence; both succeeded and observed blocked attempts count as malicious attempts
truth_policy.normal_preparatory_events: not automatically positive because actor or episode is malicious
truth_policy.unobserved: UNKNOWN, never benign; report capture/observable-episode coverage by source/type
truth_policy.read_only_private_sidecar: episode/member/time/object/policy/evidence call IDs with original file hashes
truth_policy.heldout_truth_and_prevalence: do not rebalance test or delete failures; source-specific coverage differences stay visible

readiness_policy: all 15 taxonomy rows remain visible. No model calls until gates are satisfied. A reduced common subset requires a separately frozen protocol version and coverage statement; cannot silently drop unsupported types or replace current attacks with legacy engine.

stage1_capability_validation.new_attack_backend: general workflow with shared native tools; never switch to legacy just for attacks
